caption:
Every breakfast on our expeditions comes from the valley it sits in.

On Day 4 of the Trail Running Expedition, you eat before the crossing into the Savegre. The morning opens at 1,800 metres in Providencia with gallo pinto, plantain and hot coffee. The stage covers 25 kilometres, gaining 1,380 metres and dropping 2,351 metres to Ranchos Tinamú.

Further down the valley, local families wait along the trail with fruit, hot agua dulce and empanadas from their wood stoves to carry you through the final climb into Cerro Nara.

The Trail Running Expedition. 6 to 8 athletes. Departures 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, and 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
